text:
morgan: Quick FYI — opened PR #4389 for the invoke/schema docs cleanup. Main changes: tighten JSON examples, add fallback parsing guidance, and fix two broken links. Please skim the examples for accuracy. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4389 :eyes:

alex: Thanks! I'll take the schema bits. Which examples are problematic?

morgan: The response envelope example had an extra nesting level (array wrapped). Changed from:

```json
{"result": [{"action":"search","query":"a"}]}
```

to:

```json
{"result": {"action":"search","query":"a"}}
```

morgan: That change affects the SDK snippet in src/sdk/snippets/invoke.md — I updated it, but want a second pair of eyes on the code sample.

priya: Noted. I'll run the snippets locally. Are there unit tests for the sample parser?

ben: CI is failing on the lint for the fenced code blocks (line length). Happy to fix after review.

alex: Quick thought: add an explicit parse_fallback example showing the shim for nullable tool output. Small snippet:

```json
{"action": "create", "payload": null}
```

alex: then in text show how to handle nulls when converting to typed object.

doc-bot: Reminder: docs linter requires "schema" code blocks to include a $schema declaration. Missing in one file.

morgan: Added $schema in schema examples. Also replaced two dead links (old internal gist) with the repo example files.

priya: Ran the snippet smoke tests — parsing example passes, but the example that uses streaming tool calls needs clearer guidance about chunk boundaries. I'll add a short paragraph.

ben: I'll re-run lint and push fix commit. Anyone ok with squashing to a single commit before merge?

alex: Squash sounds good.

morgan: Great — target merge window today after @ben's lint fix. @ben ping when pushed and I'll merge if CI green. Thanks all :raised_hands:
